race.description: Huntsville Standing At Cobbitty Equine Farm Mbl Pace
race.comment: DESSIE GEE (8) has been producing some good efforts in strong company of late, last seen when beaten 6 metres into fourth behind The Last Trip. Has to contend with a wide draw but finds a nice race so is a winning hope with even luck. BETTER ECLIPSE (10) enjoyed a class drop when he finished third last start at this circuit and distance. Cops the outside barrier but comes back further in grade. ALTA WILLIAM (9) did a good job as runner-up to The Last Trip last start. Draws wide so may need some luck but another win could be imminent. CYA ART NZ (4) gets his lowest draw since he placed at Newcastle last month. Player.
